note: Hypothetical safe havens for the demo walk, placed by the team on the walking route (near the halfway and three-quarter points of the all-stops route, at least 60 m from any stop). No such hardware exists on Mars; they show how pre-placed supplies and a shelter change the plan.

havens.name: Supply cache (spare O₂)
havens.note: Pre-placed spare suit O₂ bottles. Walking here refills the suit to full (10 min swap).

havens.name: Storm shelter (parked rover)
havens.note: A parked pressurized rover: reach it with the O₂ reserve intact and you are safe.
